edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom().
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing a delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and the whole supply to msg.sender.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected Uniswap pair address.
ensure() requires condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath after only a >= require.
transferFrom() increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom() reads and writes the allowance mapping.
delegate() performs a delegatecall, giving arbitrary code control of this contract's storage.
Parameter a of delegate() is the target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate() is the raw calldata of the delegatecall.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] for every recipient.
Constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without SafeMath.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
callOptionalReturn() performs a low-level call to the token address.
_transfer() updates the _balances mapping.
_mint() increases _totalSupply.
_burn() decreases _totalSupply.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner address.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() whitelists the hardcoded UNI router address.
condition() enforces the _saleNum limit against _onSaleNum.
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init() assigns _minSale based on the token parameter.
init() assigns _maxSale based on the maxToken parameter.
init() assigns _saleNum.
setTradeAddress() writes the whitelist entry that bypasses ensure().
_approve() writes the _allowances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only used as the recipient argument of transfer(); it collapses into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value is only used as the amount argument of transfer(); it collapses into the transfer function node.
Parameter _from of transferFrom() denotes the debited account and collapses into transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transferFrom() denotes the credited account and collapses into transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transferFrom() drives the allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key in approve().
Parameter _value is only used as the stored allowance value in approve().
Parameter _from of ensure() is used only for the whitelist comparisons in ensure().
Parameter _to of ensure() is used only for the owner whitelist comparison in ensure().
Parameter _value of ensure() is forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
Local _UNI is the pairFor result used only for the whitelist check in ensure().
Parameter _from of condition() indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
Parameter _value of condition() is range-checked against _minSale/_maxSale.
Parameter a is the untrusted delegatecall target of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the untrusted delegatecall payload of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter saleNum is written into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token is used to derive _minSale in init().
Parameter maxToken is used to derive _maxSale in init().
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend().
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount used by batchSend().
Local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
Local i is only the batchSend() loop counter.
Local _to is the current batchSend() recipient alias.
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory is only fed into the pair hash in pairFor().
Parameter tokenA is only sorted and hashed in pairFor().
Parameter tokenB is only sorted and hashed in pairFor().
Local token0 is the sorted lower token address in pairFor().
Local token1 is the sorted higher token address in pairFor().
Local pair is the computed return value of pairFor().

Parameter _symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _supply feeds the unchecked totalSupply multiplication in the constructor.

Parameter recipient is the credited account inside _transfer().
Parameter amount is the transferred quantity inside _transfer().

Parameter amount is the minted quantity inside _mint().
Parameter account is the debited account inside _burn().
Parameter amount is the burned quantity inside _burn().
Parameter owner is the allowance key in the internal _approve().
Parameter spender is the allowance key in the internal _approve().
Parameter amount is the stored allowance value in the internal _approve().

Parameter data is the calldata of the low-level call in callOptionalReturn().
